description: In combination with `historical`, quantifies the climate response to tropospheric ozone changes from all precursors (CH4, NMVOCs, CO, NOx). Same as `historical`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) emissions are held at 1850 values, and methane is held at 1850 values in the chemistry scheme only (it evolves as in `historical` in the radiation scheme).
branch_information: Branch from `piControl` at a time of your choosing
